title: English Composition: Connect, Collaborate, Communicate
description: This OER textbook has been designed for students to learn the foundational concepts for English 100 (first-year college composition). The content aligns to learning outcomes across all campuses in the University of Hawai'i system. It was designed, written, and edited during a three day book sprint in May, 2019.
authors: Ann Inoshita - Author / Karyl Garland - Author / Kate Sims - Author / Jeanne K. Tsutsui Keuma - Author / Tasha Williams - Author
